title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Eblasakimab in Male or Female Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis Patients Previously Treated with Dupilumab.
official: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Eblasakimab in Male or Female Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis Patients Previously Treated with Dupilumab.
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of eblasakimab in participants with moderate-to severe AD previously treated with dupilumab.
